meta.requirement: Explore Whispering Woods (5%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Pot on the Path
start.text:
''A woman with a baby on her hip is fishing an empty basket out of a stream.''

Jutta: Could you hold the handle a second? He's trying to get in there too.

Got_it.text: Jutta: Thanks. My sister's coming off her woodcutting shift and I brought lunch, or I brought the things for lunch. He pushed the basket in while I was getting the pot ready.

Can_I_get_you_something_.text: Jutta: Two Radish, a Carrot and a Mushroom would do it. I can't go looking with him like this. Would you bring them here?

I_ll_find_some.text: Jutta: That's kind of you. I'll get the water going.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Gather 2 Radish, 1 Carrot and 1 Mushroom and bring them to Jutta in the Whispering Woods

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Talk to Jutta

Talk_to_Jutta.text: Jutta: Have you found anything for the pot?

Still_looking.text: Jutta: No rush, he's finally sitting still.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Gather 2 Radish, 1 Carrot and 1 Mushroom and bring them to Jutta in the Whispering Woods

I_ve_got_all_of_it_.text:
''Jutta catches the baby's hand before it reaches the ladle and moves the ladle to the other side of the pot.''

Jutta: Those'll do. If you'd like to learn it, you can cook while I hold him.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Cook Radish Veggie Soup with Jutta in the Whispering Woods

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Cook with Jutta

Cook_with_Jutta.title: 🍳 Cooking Lesson
Cook_with_Jutta.text:
Jutta: Between ten and twelve seconds, then take it off.

[img:../Textures/Items/Foods/Item_Radish_Veggie_Soup.webp]'''Radish Veggie Soup'''
Perfect: 10-12s


Finish the cooking test within 10 minutes to continue. Failing will make you do it again.

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Talk to Jutta

Talk_to_Jutta__.text: Jutta: This gives you Haste for three hours, so your Hunt, Explore, Forage and Mine cooldowns are half as long. You can use it three times a week. Eating another just refreshes the three hours.

choices.label: Can I buy it somewhere too?

Can_I_buy_it_somewhere_too_.text: Jutta: Mm-hm, Dawn Winery has it on the menu. Buying a bowl counts toward the same limit when you eat it.

____Pot_on_the_Path__Lunch_Ready.title: Lunch Ready
____Pot_on_the_Path__Lunch_Ready.text: Jutta: Here's your bowl and a bit for the trouble. My sister should be along soon, so I'll put hers aside.
